### Build the Lord’s House First
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/build-the-lords-house-first-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Haggai 1:7-9
Points:
- The returned exiles halted temple reconstruction to focus entirely on their own homes and livelihoods.
- Their hard work produced little fruit, leaving them feeling continually empty and exhausted.
- God showed His people that their persistent dissatisfaction stemmed directly from disordered priorities.
- The cure for spiritual fruitlessness is not working harder, but intentionally creating space for God.
- True nourishment and satisfaction come only when the Lord's presence is given first place.

### Will Graham Devotion: Struggling to Prioritize?
Author: Will Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/articles/will-graham-devotion-struggling-to-prioritize?ri=wc
Passage: Haggai 1:4-8
Points:
- Believers often allow worldly pursuits, hobbies, and comforts to crowd out devotion to God.
- The Israelites invested in paneled houses for themselves while leaving God's house in ruins.
- Their perpetual lack of satisfaction and meager harvests were consequences of their disobedience.
- God called for immediate repentance and action through three marching orders: go, bring, and build.
- Laying down personal idols and restoring God to Lordship brings spiritual renewal and fulfillment.
